briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 launch intensifies multi-lab AGI race with new safety benchmarks

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs accelerate model releases as compute scaling continues unabated. Regulatory scrutiny grows while investment surges into infrastructure and safety tooling.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI released o4 with 4.2T parameters; Anthropic countered with Claude 4 Opus; xAI Grok-3 and DeepSeek-R2 both hit production this week.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level for multi-agent and BCI deployments.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA ships Blackwell B200 clusters to Microsoft and Google; TSMC begins 2nm AI chip production ramp; new Middle East hyperscale sites announced.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will the first 10T-parameter model trigger an international compute-sharing treaty before 2027?
